headline_marked: 4 arrested after [[man killed in Tazia procession dispute]] in Old Dhaka
headline: 4 arrested after man killed in Tazia procession dispute in Old Dhaka
summary: Police apprehended four suspects, including three minors, after a sanitation worker was fatally stabbed over a dispute regarding the ropes of a palanquin.
details: Police have arrested four people in connection with the fatal stabbing of Jakir Hossain, a 31-year-old sanitation worker, during an Ashura Tazia procession in Old Dhaka's Sutrapur.
The incident occurred on Friday afternoon on PK Roy Road in Banglabazar, where Jakir was repeatedly stabbed after being chased out of the procession.
According to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police, the killing was triggered by an altercation and subsequent scuffle over holding the ropes of a Duli (palanquin).
Jakir attempted to seek safety beneath the Ispahani Building, but he was cornered and fatally attacked by the suspects.
Police cracked the case within 12 hours, identifying the perpetrators through CCTV footage and conducting overnight raids between 1am and 7am.
Among the detainees is 20-year-old Mohammad Rashed, while the other three arrested suspects are minors.
Law enforcement recovered a switchblade, a machete, and the clothing worn by the suspects during the attack.
Operations are currently underway to apprehend other identified criminals involved in the assault.
caption:
A minor dispute over holding the ropes of a palanquin ended in tragedy in Old Dhaka.

Police have arrested four people in connection with the fatal stabbing of Jakir Hossain, a 31-year-old sanitation worker, during an Ashura Tazia procession in Old Dhaka's Sutrapur.

The incident occurred on Friday afternoon on PK Roy Road in Banglabazar, where Jakir was repeatedly stabbed after being chased out of the procession.

According to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police, the killing was triggered by an altercation and subsequent scuffle over holding the ropes of a Duli (palanquin).

Jakir attempted to seek safety beneath the Ispahani Building, but he was cornered and fatally attacked by the suspects.

Police cracked the case within 12 hours, identifying the perpetrators through CCTV footage and conducting overnight raids between 1am and 7am.

Among the detainees is 20-year-old Mohammad Rashed, while the other three arrested suspects are minors.

Law enforcement recovered a switchblade, a machete, and the clothing worn by the suspects during the attack.

Operations are currently underway to apprehend other identified criminals involved in the assault.

headline_marked: Feni: [[Youth League worker killed]] by banned Chhatra League
headline: Feni: Youth League worker killed by banned Chhatra League
summary: A Jubo League worker was allegedly murdered by members of the banned Chhatra League in Feni district.
details: A Jubo League worker was killed in Feni, allegedly by members of the banned Chhatra League.
The incident has caused tension in the area as political affiliations within the same broader party structure clash.
Local authorities have been notified of the incident, and investigations are underway to identify and arrest the perpetrators.
This killing marks another instance of political violence in the region following the recent political shifts in Bangladesh.
